answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and, in each epoch, evaluates its committed RLN polynomial at a rate-limit identifier, proving the share without revealing it. Reusing that identifier in two valid messages exposes distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the identity secret and enables immediate collateral slashing. Epoch scoping limits exposure, while signal, yarrow, and glacier can identify separate test domains rather than security assumptions.
